column1: # Story 3.5 — 1-minute rollup queries for the 86B/24h tier.
# The rollup tables have the same tenant_id/project_generation/authz_epoch
# columns and row policies as the raw tables. The 86B/24h dataset has 86x the
# events of the 1B/24h dataset but the same rollup cardinality (dimensions x
# 1440 minutes); only the counters scale. The query latency measured here is
# therefore representative of the rollup-backed 86B tier.
